question.text: What is the cut-off time for repurchase/redemption applications in overnight fund schemes?

answer.text: 3:00 pm, extended to 7:00 pm if the application is received online
1:30 pm for all transactions regardless of mode
3:00 pm for all transactions regardless of mode
No cut-off time as overnight funds operate 24/7

explanation.text: The Logic: For repurchase/redemption applications in overnight fund schemes, the cut-off time is 3:00 pm. If the application is received online, the cut-off is extended to 7:00 pm. This extended online cut-off recognises the operational reality of overnight funds, which invest in 1-day maturity securities and are commonly used for short-term cash deployment. The Trap: The extended 7:00 pm cut-off applies only to online repurchase/redemption applications, not to physical applications and not necessarily to all overnight fund transactions in general. Note: Source - NISM-Series II-B Registrars and Transfer Agents (Mutual Fund) Certification Examination workbook (December 2025), p. 144.
